context: M18 o5. (Teddy.) W 30th St in the dark. A box truck at the Varelas dock. Plainclothes on the corner.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Collection night, and the furrier's loading coats at midnight in a blackout.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Wurtz's green sedan on the corner. Brannock smoking. Watching the dock, not the street.

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: Collector. Envelope's at the car tonight. Lieutenant's collecting personal.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Wurtz never collects personal. Unless it's big.
